thesis: CLOSE THE FULL NKE LONG — an exit instruction, so target and stop are null by design. The position (entry 40.75, opened 2026-08-17, target 62.00, no stop, now -4.0%) rested on NKE being a de-rated quality name that insiders were buying. Checked, the insider leg does not hold: all five open-market purchases are from 2026-04-07 to 2026-04-13 at 42.27-43.34, five months stale and every one underwater against Friday's 38.40. Relative strength says the same thing — NKE lags SPY by 47.19% over six months and its own sector ETF XLY by 33.05%. And I can put no defensible valuation on the 62.00 target: the Sept-quarter consensus is $0.4523 on $11.48B, so the stock is not obviously cheap on forward earnings, and at an honest target of 48 against a 33 bear case the position returns 0.63:1 — far under the 2.5 long-term floor. A position I would not open, cannot value, and whose evidence has expired is a position to close.
key_risk: Closing three weeks before the 2026-09-28 print risks selling the low: 38.40 is 1.19% off the 250-day low of 37.95, the last quarter beat EPS estimates by 50.2%, and a beat there is the single most likely thing to re-rate the stock. The limit is set at 37.90 partly for this reason — below the 250-day low it will not fill, which is itself information.
counter_argument: The strongest case for holding is that everything I list as bearish is backward-looking and the catalyst is ahead: consensus has capitulated to a 39.1% bullish share, the CEO and three other insiders committed $3.73M of their own money, and the last print beat by 50%. That is a real setup and it may work. It is not a reason to hold a position at 0.63:1 against its own bear case with no stop — if the Sept 28 print is the thesis, the trade is to buy it after the print on evidence, not to sit through it on a lapsed one.
